methods.label: Model meeting and catching up
methods.explanation: Let the faster person's speed be \(x\) km/h and the slower person's speed be \(y\) km/h. Meeting gives \(2(x+y)=36\), and catching up gives \(6(x-y)=36\). Thus, \(x+y=18\) and \(x-y=6\). Solving gives \(x=12\), \(y=6\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 meeting and catch-up relationships and a simple two-variable linear system.
